About Our Brand and Products

viaim creates AI-powered wearable devices designed to help professionals capture conversations, generate accurate transcripts, and stay focused during meetings, interviews, calls, and daily work.

Our mission is simple: help people remember more, write less, and work smarter.

viaim products combine open-ear comfort, AI transcription, intelligent summarization, and all-day usability into one seamless productivity solution.

What Makes Us Different

Unlike traditional voice recorders or note-taking apps, viaim is built for modern professionals who need hands-free, AI-assisted productivity.

Key advantages include:

• One-tap recording without needing to open an app

• AI-powered transcription and meeting summaries

• Open-ear design for all-day comfort and situational awareness

• No need to constantly check your phone during conversations

• Designed specifically for meetings, interviews, sales calls, research, and business communication

• Hardware + AI software experience in one ecosystem

How Partners Can Earn

Partners earn commissions for qualifying purchases made through their unique referral link.

You can earn by introducing Viaim to:

• Colleagues and teammates

• Clients and professional networks

• Social media audiences

• Blog readers and newsletter subscribers

• Communities and professional groups

Top-performing partners may qualify for additional incentives and partnership opportunities.

How to Promote viaim

Partners are encouraged to share authentic experiences and real-world use cases.

Popular promotion methods include:

• Product reviews and comparisons

• YouTube videos and demonstrations

• LinkedIn posts and professional content

• Blog articles and newsletters

• Productivity, AI, and business communities

• Client and colleague recommendations

The most successful partners focus on demonstrating how Viaim improves productivity and helps professionals capture important conversations.

Other Information

• Free to join

• Dedicated partner support

• Real-time referral tracking dashboard

• Marketing assets available

• Monthly commission payouts

• Open to creators, consultants, business professionals, and existing Viaim customers

If you have questions about the program, please contact us at store@viaim.ai.

viaim Partner Program Terms & Conditions

Welcome to the viaim Partner Program.

These Terms & Conditions govern your participation in the viaim Partner Program ("Program"). By applying to or participating in the Program, you agree to comply with these terms.

1. Application & Approval

All applications are subject to review and approval by viaim.

We reserve the right to approve or reject any application at our sole discretion and may remove any participant from the Program at any time if these terms are violated.

2. Referral Links & Tracking

Once approved, you will receive a unique referral link and access to your partner dashboard.

Referrals are tracked through your unique link and/or any approved referral code assigned to your account.

If a customer interacts with multiple referral links, the referral will generally be attributed according to the tracking rules established by Viaim.

Referral links, discount codes, and promotional materials may only be used in accordance with Program guidelines.

3. Commissions & Rewards

Partners are eligible to earn commissions or rewards for qualifying purchases made through their referral links.

Commission rates, qualification requirements, payment thresholds, and promotional incentives may be updated periodically and will be communicated through the partner dashboard or official program communications.

Commissions are calculated based on the final order value excluding taxes, shipping fees, refunds, and chargebacks.

Orders that are canceled, refunded, disputed, fraudulent, or otherwise deemed invalid will not qualify for commission payments.

4. Payment

To receive commission payments, partners must provide valid payment information within their partner account.

Approved commissions will be paid according to the payment schedule communicated by Viaim.

Viaim reserves the right to review referral activity before issuing payments.

5. Promotional Guidelines

Partners may promote viaim through websites, blogs, newsletters, social media channels, communities, events, professional networks, or other lawful marketing methods.

Partners may not:

  • Make false or misleading claims about Viaim products or services

  • Impersonate viaim employees or representatives

  • Engage in spam, deceptive advertising, or unethical marketing practices

  • Bid on viaim trademark terms in paid search campaigns without written permission

  • Use unauthorized coupon codes or promotional offers

6. Marketing Resources

viaim may provide approved marketing assets including logos, product images, banners, messaging guidelines, and other promotional materials.

These materials may only be used for the purpose of promoting Viaim and must not be altered in a misleading manner.

7. Cookie Tracking

Referral tracking may utilize cookies and other tracking technologies.

The applicable referral attribution window will be displayed within the partner dashboard.

If tracking cannot be completed due to browser restrictions, cookie deletion, ad blockers, privacy settings, or other technical limitations, Viaim may be unable to attribute commissions.

8. Program Modifications

viaim reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate the Program, commission structure, rewards, eligibility requirements, or these Terms & Conditions at any time.

Any material changes will be communicated through official program channels.

9. Termination
